headline: Stonecradle Front Surges as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition, StonecradleHex has become the sharpest hinge on the map, registering eleven base events in the latest two hours and fourteen in twenty-four; its holdings now stand at eight Colonial to one Warden, against the former five-to-four split. MooringCountyHex is also stirring at close quarters, with three events in two hours and six across the day, while its balance has shifted to nine Warden bases and three Colonial, from ten to two. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the great furnace: thirty-four events in twenty-four hours, fifteen in six, and casualties accelerating for both sides, though no event appears in the latest two-hour window. FarranacCoastHex has cooled to two events in six hours and none in two, despite nine across the day. LinnMercyHex retains all eleven bases under Colonial control, with seven daily events but no recent turnover. FishermansRowHex likewise shows fourteen daily events, yet no movement in six hours, an old front presently quiet. Elsewhere, Callahans Passage is producing heavy and accelerating casualty totals without recorded base events, while most peripheral sectors remain still.
